UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores learner onboarding profile, preferences, and account details isolated per authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner.

email.description: Verified email address of the learner.

phoneNumber.description: Optional phone number provided during onboarding.

topicsOfInterest.description: Selected topics of interest (tech, history, finances, etc.).

learnerType.description: Self-identified learner pace and style (fast-learner, slow and steady, etc.).

preferredTools.description: Preferred learning tools (AI assistance, note-taking, videos, reading, audio recordings, etc.).

onboardingCompleted.description: Whether the learner has completed the initial onboarding questionnaire.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

Course.title: Course
Course.description: Stores a personalized course generated by Billy, including configuration, modules, lessons, notebook, and saved Billy chat history.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the course owner.

topicPrompt.description: Original user prompt or scenario for the course.

category.description: Visual category identifier for picture theming.

isCompleted.description: Whether the learner has completed all lessons in the course.

configJson.description: Serialized course configuration (modality percentages, history depth, tone, pace, length, assignment settings, prior experience, sources).

modulesJson.description: Serialized array of modules, lessons, visual diagrams, audio scripts, and adaptive assignments.

notebook.description: Built-in learner notebook content saved to this course.

chatHistoryJson.description: Serialized array of Billy chat messages saved to this course for reference.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when course was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when course was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Learner profiles isolated per authenticated user ID.

/courses/{courseId}.description: Personalized courses owned by a specific authenticated user.
